register.labelZh: BLOW 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: BLOW 片語動詞可以表示風吹走物件、吹倒樹木、吹掉東西,或表示風暴已經過去。；你可以用 BLOW 片語動詞表示把球吹脹、把空氣或煙吹出、吹熄火焰,或描述輪胎爆裂。；blow somebody away 可以表示非常驚訝或欣賞;在主要為美式的體育英語中,blow somebodyout 可以表示以大比數取勝。；BLOW 片語動詞也可以表示故意不出席、故意不理會某人、突然到來或爆炸。你需要按情境判斷意思。
register.summaryEn: BLOW expressions can show that wind carries something away, knocks a tree down or removes an object, and that a storm has passed. You can use BLOW expressions to inflate a ball, force air or smoke out, extinguish a flame or describe a tyre bursting. Blow somebody away can show great surprise or admiration. In mainly American sports English, blow somebody out can describe a very large win. BLOW expressions can also describe skipping an event, ignoring someone, arriving unexpectedly or an explosion. The situation tells you which meaning is intended.
